lines.en: Deep in the jungles of southeast Asia lurks a deadly creature with sharp teeth and a venomous bite: a slow loris.
lines.zh: 在东南亚丛林深处，潜伏着一种致命的生物：它长着锋利的牙齿，一口咬下去带毒——这就是懒猴。

lines.en: Despite their wide-eyed looks, their story is much fiercer than you might imagine.
lines.zh: 别看它们睁着一双大眼睛显得无辜，它们背后的故事可比你想象的凶悍得多。

lines.en: Lorises split off from other primates as far back as 70 million years ago, when T-rexes still roamed.
lines.zh: 懒猴早在七千万年前就从其他灵长类里分化出来了，那时候霸王龙还在大地上游荡。

lines.en: And they gradually migrated from Africa to Asia.
lines.zh: 之后它们逐渐从非洲迁徙到了亚洲。

lines.en: Around sunset each evening, lorises get active, moving slowly and deliberately through the trees in their home range.
lines.zh: 每天接近日落时，懒猴开始活跃，在自己的活动范围内缓慢而从容地在树林间移动。

lines.en: They use their large eyes to scan their surroundings for their next meal and take little time to rest.
lines.zh: 它们用那双大眼睛扫视四周，寻找下一顿饭食，几乎不怎么停下来休息。

lines.en: Pygmy lorises, for one, regularly pass their nights in near-constant motion.
lines.zh: 就拿倭懒猴来说，它们几乎整夜都在不停地活动。

lines.en: Unlike many other primates, however, slow lorises have a higher proportion of slow-twitch muscle fibers, which are favored for long-winded exertion versus speedy spurts.
lines.zh: 不过和许多其他灵长类不同，懒猴体内慢肌纤维的比例更高——这种纤维适合长时间的持续用力，而不是短时间爆发。

lines.en: They also have extra vertebrae, making them especially flexible.
lines.zh: 它们的脊椎骨也多出几节，这让它们格外灵活。

lines.en: When needed, slow lorises can stay still, gripped to one tree branch for hours, extra blood vessel networks in their limbs preventing them from weakening or becoming numb.
lines.zh: 需要的时候，懒猴可以一动不动地抓着同一根树枝待上好几个小时——它们四肢里额外的血管网络，能防止肌肉变弱或发麻。

lines.en: Their slow movements help them go undetected.
lines.zh: 这种缓慢的移动方式，让它们不容易被发现。

lines.en: And that way, they avoid threats, staying stealth around predators that tend to be on the lookout for motion; and they can better hunt unsuspecting prey.
lines.zh: 这样一来既能避开威胁：许多天敌是靠「有没有东西在动」来搜寻猎物的，而懒猴保持隐蔽就能不被察觉；同时它们也能更有效地去捕捉那些毫无防备的猎物。

lines.en: Slow lorises are omnivores that go after lots of insects and other small animals, as well as fruit and nectar.
lines.zh: 懒猴是杂食动物，会捕食大量昆虫和其他小动物，也吃果实和花蜜。

lines.en: Interestingly, they also consume a lot of tree gum and sap, scratching at tree bark with a row of specialized teeth called a “toothcomb.
lines.zh: 有意思的是，它们还会吃掉大量的树胶和树液，用一排被称作「齿梳」的特化牙齿去刮树皮。

lines.en: ” Though these plant substances are tough to digest, slow lorises seem to be well-equipped to detoxify them.
lines.zh: 虽然这些植物分泌物很难消化，懒猴却似乎装备齐全，能够分解其中的毒素。

lines.en: Some scientists even suspect that they sequester the toxins from the tree gum they devour because slow lorises are, in fact, toxic themselves.
lines.zh: 有些科学家甚至怀疑，它们是把吞下的树胶里的毒素积存到了自己体内——因为懒猴本身就是有毒的。

lines.en: They’re the only venomous primates, and one of only a few venomous mammals.
lines.zh: 它们是唯一有毒的灵长类，也是极少数有毒的哺乳动物之一。

lines.en: And their venom system is thought to be one of the most complex in the animal kingdom.
lines.zh: 而它们的毒液系统，被认为是动物界里最复杂的一种。

lines.en: It works in two parts, with the combination of two separate secretions.
lines.zh: 它分成两个部分运作，靠两种分泌物混合才能生效。

lines.en: When threatened, slow lorises may assume their venom pose, raising their arms so they can easily access glands near their armpits that secrete a toxic oil.
lines.zh: 遇到威胁时，懒猴会摆出「施毒姿势」：举起手臂，好让自己能够到腋下的腺体——那里会分泌一种有毒的油脂。

lines.en: When they lick at the glands, the oil combines with their saliva to form their formidable, flesh-rotting venom.
lines.zh: 它们去舔这个腺体时，油脂与唾液混合，形成了那种令人生畏、能让皮肉溃烂的毒液。

lines.en: They store the mixture on their sharp toothcomb, to be deployed with a bite capable of causing intense pain, tissue damage, anaphylaxis, and, in small animals, even death.
lines.zh: 它们把混合好的毒液储存在锋利的齿梳上，随时可以通过咬一口释放出去——那一口能造成剧痛、组织损伤和过敏性休克，对小动物来说甚至足以致命。

lines.en: Slow lorises spread the oil over their coats where it can kill parasites on contact.
lines.zh: 懒猴还会把油脂涂遍全身的毛发，寄生虫一碰上就会被杀死。

lines.en: In fact, the number of parasites they carry on their skin and fur is remarkably low relative to other primates.
lines.zh: 事实上，相比其他灵长类，它们皮肤和毛发上携带的寄生虫数量少得惊人。

lines.en: And it may also be protective against bigger threats.
lines.zh: 而且这可能对更大的威胁同样有防护作用。

lines.en: When slow lorises sleep, they curl into little balls, toxic coats exposed, perhaps to help deter predators.
lines.zh: 懒猴睡觉时会缩成一个小球，把有毒的毛发露在外面，也许是为了帮助吓退捕食者。

lines.en: Cats, sun bears, and civets are repelled by just the scent of slow loris saliva— though orangutans seem to have found a way around it.
lines.zh: 猫、马来熊和灵猫，光是闻到懒猴唾液的气味就会被吓退——不过红毛猩猩似乎找到了绕开这一招的办法。

lines.en: The most common victims of slow loris bites, however, are other slow lorises.
lines.zh: 然而，被懒猴咬伤最常见的受害者，恰恰是另一只懒猴。

lines.en: Tracking one population over the course of eight years, scientists only recorded one slow loris dying from natural predation.
lines.zh: 科学家对一个族群追踪了八年，期间只记录到一只懒猴死于天敌捕食。

lines.en: But 20% of them got bitten by other slow lorises, perhaps in fights over limited territory.
lines.zh: 但其中 20% 的个体被其他懒猴咬伤过，也许是在争夺有限的领地时。

lines.en: And while they may look cute to us, those same features might send a very different message to predators at dusk.
lines.zh: 虽然在我们的眼里它们一副可爱的样子，但同样的那些特征，在黄昏时分传递给捕食者的，可能是完全不同的信息。

lines.en: When in danger, slow lorises may assume their venom pose, sway, and make a raspy noise.
lines.zh: 遇到危险时，懒猴会摆出施毒的姿势，身体左右摇摆，并发出嘶哑的声音。

lines.en: Some scientists think these behaviors and their markings might help them effectively mimic spectacled cobras.
lines.zh: 一些科学家认为，这些举动加上它们身上的斑纹，可能帮助它们有效地模仿了眼镜蛇。

lines.en: This could be an example of Müllerian mimicry, where one dangerous species benefits from sharing certain characteristics with another, helping warn other creatures to stay away.
lines.zh: 这可能是缪勒氏拟态的一个例子：一个危险的物种，通过和另一个危险物种共享某些特征而受益，共同警告其他生物离远一点。

lines.en: But if slow lorises evolved to look like cobras, we don't seem to be getting the memo.
lines.zh: 但如果懒猴真的是为了像眼镜蛇才演化成这样，我们人类似乎完全没收到这个信号。

lines.en: Though every species of slow loris is threatened, humans continue to illegally trade them as pets, stripped of their natural defenses, their teeth cut or pulled.
lines.zh: 尽管每一种懒猴都已濒危，人类仍在非法把它们当作宠物买卖，剥去它们的天然防御——把它们的牙齿剪断或者拔掉。

lines.en: It’s well past time to pick up on the signals they’ve been sending and leave the fierce slow loris— and their forests— alone.
lines.zh: 早该读懂它们一直在发出的这些信号了：放过这种凶悍的懒猴，也放过它们栖息的森林。
